items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...the picture with Henry Allen Senior's band... [INTERVIEWEE] He's been up there for years in California.

ctx.x: That's the way I think it's in the picture with the Allen band. He played, I think it was the say alto or was his instrument? Yeah. Alto was his instrument. He was in that band, the picture with Henry Allen Senior's band over in Al Jair. That's right. When did he go to California?

He's been up there for years in California. He lived in Chicago. He lived in Chicago. He lived in Chicago. He lived in Chicago. And then he went to California. He's married a second time since the third. His first wife died here. And he's married a second time since he married a second wife and the third wife.
